name: Direct Invoices – Invoicing & Payment Requests for WordPress
author: Digages

sections.description:
Direct Invoices for WordPress makes it easy to create invoices, send payment requests, track payment status, generate receipts, and manage clients directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Send invoices through Email, WhatsApp, and Telegram, collect payments online, and keep your billing process organized.

Whether you’re a business owner, freelancer, agency, consultant, coach, or service provider, Direct Invoices helps you get paid faster while keeping everything under your control.

With Direct Invoices, you can easily request and accept payments via:

  • Bank Transfers – International & Local
  • Mobile Money – MTN MoMo, M-Pesa, Airtel, Vodafone, and many more
  • Crypto Payments – BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, BNB, ADA, MATIC, and many more
  • Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Platforms – Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, GCash, Cash App, Apple Pay, Monzo, Google Pay, Payoneer, Skrill, Paytm, Monzo, Wise, and many more
  • Stripe – Accept card payments worldwide with Stripe across 150+ countries and 135+ currencies.
  • WooCommerce Checkout – Accept invoice payments with the existing 1,000+ WooCommerce gateways.

Unlock all features with Pro Version

Why use Direct Invoices by Digages?

  • Professional Invoices: Create beautiful invoices for products, services, subscriptions, and custom projects.
  • Payment Requests: Send payment requests directly to clients.
  • PDF Invoices: Generate and download professional PDF invoices.
  • Any Payment Method: Let your customers pay with their preferred options — bank transfers, mobile money, crypto or P2P platforms.
  • Zero Transaction Fees: Keep 100% of your revenue with no hidden costs or fees.
  • Fast Setup: Go from installation to requesting payments in minutes, with our intuitive setup wizard.
  • Payment Receipts: Automatically generate and send receipts after successful payments.
  • WhatsApp Invoices [PRO]: Send invoices and payment reminders directly through WhatsApp.
  • Telegram Invoices [PRO]: Deliver invoices and payment reminders through Telegram.
  • Invoice Tracking: Track invoice status including Draft, Sent, Paid, Completed, and Overdue.
  • Recurring Invoices [PRO]: Automatically generate recurring invoices for subscriptions and ongoing services.
  • Smart Payment Reminders [PRO]: Create multiple reminder schedules before and after the due date.
  • Unlimited Payment Methods [PRO]: Upgrade from the single payment method in the free version to unlimited payment methods with Pro, allowing you to offer more flexibility to your customers and boost sales.
  • Email Notifications: Notify clients when invoices are created, updated, paid, or overdue.
  • Multiple Currencies [PRO]: Create invoices in different currencies for international clients.
  • Simple Dashboard Management: Manage invoices, receipts, and payments directly from WordPress.
  • Translation Ready: Fully compatible with translation plugins like Loco Translate.
  • Premium Support [PRO]: Create support tickets and get fast, prioritized assistance to resolve any issues quickly.

sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard:

  • Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New Plugin from the left-hand menu.
  • In the search box, type Direct Invoices by Digages.
  • Click on Install Now when you see the Digages Direct Invoices.
  • After installation, click Activate.
sections.faq:
What payment methods are supported?

Direct Invoices supports a wide range of payment options, including bank transfers, mobile money (MTN, M-Pesa, Airtel, etc.), peer-to-peer platforms (Venmo, PayPal, Cash App, Zelle, etc.), and more.

You can also allow customers to pay through your WooCommerce checkout, giving you access to 1,000+ payment gateways.

Can I customize the invoice templates?

Yes. You can add your logo, customize invoice colors, and edit the Email, WhatsApp, and Telegram message templates to match your business branding.

What’s the difference between the Free and Pro versions?

The free version includes all the core invoicing tools, including invoice creation, payment tracking, PDF invoices, receipts, email notifications, and online payments.

The PRO version unlocks all features, including Smart Payment Reminders, WhatsApp and Telegram invoices, recurring invoices, custom branding, multiple currencies, and premium support.

Will Direct Invoices slow my website?

No, Direct Invoices is optimized for performance and will not slow down your website. It integrates seamlessly with WordPress.

How can I upgrade to PRO?

You can purchase the PRO license from our plugin website and the plugin’s settings page. The Pro Version offers unlimited payment methods, email confirmations, and advanced customization options.
